bt:String.DefaultValue: Open the SÄZÄN PowerCalc tab to build load calcs, panel schedules and studies.

Adds one row to the Load Calc section your cursor is in, keeping the section formatting.

Load Calc: adds or removes an optional section (Refrigeration, Kitchen, Elevators, EV, Fire, Process). Logging Demand: adds or removes the interval-data blocks and load duration curve.
Places the selected Load Calc rows on a panel, switchboard or MCC at the circuit you choose, as live links. Ckts / Placed / Status track what has been moved.
Moves the selected circuit (sub-feed, Load Calc load or manual entry) to the circuit number you choose, or swaps two circuits. Linked rows stay locked; registry and Load Calc tracking follow.
Rescans every schedule and updates the Ckts / Placed / Status columns on Load Calc (picks up circuits cleared or moved on a panel).
